# archestra_identity_provider (Data Source)

Finds an identity provider by its provider ID. Its secrets are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "archestra_identity_provider" "okta" {
  provider_id = "okta"
}

output "okta_issuer" {
  value = data.archestra_identity_provider.okta.issuer
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) Provider ID of the identity provider, as used in its sign-in URL.

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String) Email domain the provider signs in.
- `id` (String) Identity Provider ID.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer URL.
- `sso_login_enabled` (Boolean) Whether people can sign in with it.
